pkgmetadata.longdescription: Sidra is an Apple Music desktop client that wraps music.apple.com in a CastLabs Electron build with Widevine DRM support. It provides native Linux integration through MPRIS, desktop notifications, a system tray indicator, Last.fm scrobbling and Discord Rich Presence.
